audit_note: Calibration verdicts, as a list of model-pair runs (Section 11.4). Run A is the project's primary same-model measurement (deepseek-v4.1-flash per-case comparator; Run 1 batched retained in verdicts.batched.json). Run B is the first cross-model measurement: the corpus (all 23 cases) judged blind by claude-sonnet-5, family claude, producer deepseek. Both pairs detect 19/19 mutations with 0/4 control false positives. The pairs differ on one typed label only: CAL-006 (quantifier_change) is formal_stronger under the per-case deepseek run but formal_weaker under claude -- and claude agrees with deepseek's batched label. CAL-G010 (saturation_order) is incomparable in both runs; its read-back was re-pointed by the Session-124 operator fix (see seeded.json audit_note), under which it is the same genuine mismatch as the hand-authored CAL-005, and claude's pre-fix reading of it was equivalent (the correct reading of the then-non-mutation, which is what exposed the corpus bug).

runs.note: Run A: per-case same-model pass (Run 1 batched retained in verdicts.batched.json).

Run B: cross-model pass, claude-sonnet-5 blind comparator, producer deepseek. CAL-G010 recorded from the post-fix re-audit (identical in content to CAL-005); claude read the pre-fix, equivalent text as equivalent.
